title: A Neutron Star Is Just 20 Kilometers Wide
hook: A dead star can compress sunlike mass into 20 kilometers.
closing: That density shows how violently gravity can reshape matter.
question: Which is stranger: size or mass?

segments.say: A neutron star spans just 20 kilometers, roughly Manhattan's length. Gravity compresses a dead star into a city-sized object.
At 2.2 solar masses, a neutron star collapses into a black hole. Even dense matter has a limit.
Astronomers have catalogued over 3,400 neutron stars. Each discovery reveals another extreme laboratory for gravity.
